objective: Retain November DiffV2IR MFT, obtain at least +5 HOTA points over direct RGB fine-tuning, with 2-3 independently supported mechanisms inspired by visual continuity and classical algorithms.
generated_ir_semantics: Existing uint8 scalar current-RGB-derived DiffV2IR PNG; no regeneration, no physical thermal-sensor claim.

reference.detector: Single-branch YOLOX-X, fish class, same original visible initialization

hypotheses.shape: Figure-ground shape in new pseudo IR can stabilize object descriptors when RGB texture changes; spatially structured RGB/IR evidence must beat equally sized RGB-only descriptors.
hypotheses.motion: Transporting evidence with robust, forward-backward-checked local optical flow can preserve correspondence during nonlinear motion; pseudo-IR support must be checked rather than trusted.
hypotheses.permanence: Occlusion-aware competitive association and separately protected appearance/shape memories can preserve identities through crossings without blindly propagating false detections.

candidate_families: Classical local RGB/IR shape and color descriptors with cross-modal spatial agreement
Separate pretrained RGB appearance and pseudo-IR shape with reliability-aware matching
Flow-transported RGB/IR evidence with uncertainty and identity-memory protection
Train-only metric adaptation of the best supported spatial-temporal representation

iteration_policy.design_and_selection: Train and Dev only; register each concrete configuration before its replay; retain every failure and engineering diagnosis.
iteration_policy.formal_Test: All seven sequences and 15985 ordered frames for each frozen formal candidate and required ablation. No Test-driven parameter or checkpoint selection.
iteration_policy.training_epochs: Selected by complete Dev curves, with resumable checkpoints; no arbitrary claim that six epochs suffice.

required_controls: Same proposed backend and appearance capacity with RGB only
Same proposed backend with double-RGB capacity control
Each single mechanism and cumulative combination
Zero and spatially mismatched pseudo-IR interventions

acceptance.individual_contribution: Positive complete-Dev and complete-Test removal delta; report all other metrics and whether support survives seeds. Negative or neutral mechanisms receive no innovation credit.
acceptance.trained_models: Seeds 0,1,2 for final supported components and matched controls; deterministic classical modules are reported as deterministic, not fictitious seed repeats.

causality: Only current and past input images; no Test GT during inference, no future-frame access, no rewriting already emitted tracks, and reset all sequence state.

evaluation.aggregation: Official TrackEval combine_sequences; no frame or difficult-sequence exclusion.

storage.full_frame_cache: Optional bounded tmpfs only, delete after consumers finish
storage.checkpoint_policy: One atomic resumable latest and one compact best per active learned arm; hash-verified NAS archive after completion.
storage.Git: Only lightweight code, configs, reports and scientific figures; no model, crop bank, feature bank or raw predictions.

limitations: Historical Test has been exposed in prior research and is an exploratory comparison, not a new blind test.
Original visible pretraining included the current Dev videos; only new parameter fitting excludes Dev.
Existing mean/std are fitted only on the complete Train split and retained unchanged for detector reuse.
A +5-point target is an experimental acceptance criterion, never a pre-established result.

priority_backend_registration.policy: Highest complete Dev priority HOTA for the new paired global frontend, versus strongest RGB-global control including zero extra crops. Original Train-fitted RGB/IR point heads, all3 seeds, no refitting or Test selection.
priority_backend_registration.primary_role: Paired actual new-IR global detector with RGB-guided half crops, global confidence priority. This is NOT an IR-attention gain.
priority_backend_registration.control_role: Exact original single-RGB global detector; source evidence can be reused unchanged.
priority_backend_registration.capacity_limit: Paired global detector has two FPN branches, and uses additional RGB crop observations. This route is a pipeline control; it cannot establish modality novelty or equal-parameter superiority without the strict shared-encoder RGB/gray controls in the correlation campaign.
priority_backend_registration.evidence_reuse: All original box rows are kept bit-exactly. Reuse their frozen descriptors, recompute descriptors only for new boxes and point graph only for pairs touching added boxes. No GT inference input.
